name: Yost Foods
old_description: At Yost Foods, we’re a family-owned ingredient manufacturer that’s been creating custom dry and wet ingredient systems on an industrial scale since 1991. We work side by side with food manufacturers to take products from initial concept through to consistent, reliable production.
about:
Yost Foods is a family-owned custom ingredient manufacturer based in Brunswick, Ohio. Founded in 1991 by Bill Yost, the company began as an industrial food brokerage before evolving into a manufacturer of dry and wet ingredient systems for food producers.

The company produces custom dry blends — such as snack seasonings, dry sauces, and snack bases — and wet systems including marinades, sauces, hot sauces, purees, and kettle-cooked bases. Its facility features multiple production rooms separated by process type: liquid mixing for sauces and marinades, ribbon and paddle mixing for dry blends, and kettle cooking for caramelized sugars, purees, and pepper blends. Automation supports repeatable batches and scalable output from early-stage runs to high-volume production.

Yost serves national food manufacturers across categories including sauces, dressings, and marinades; refrigerated and ready-to-eat foods; frozen meals and pizzas; snacks, candy, and nuts; and ice cream and frozen desserts. The team works directly with R&D departments, food scientists, and culinary innovators to develop formulations that perform consistently in conventional and alternative product lines.

The company emphasizes collaborative development, technical expertise from food scientists and production specialists, fast sampling and rapid revisions, custom formulations with line-trial support, and consistency at scale through process control. It also provides clean-label and certification guidance for kosher, organic, gluten-free, non-GMO, and no-sugar-added claims, along with flexible packaging in bags, bag-in-box, drums, pails, and totes. A family-owned, long-term mindset drives a relationship-driven, accountable, and customer-first culture.
